_comment: App 2 / A2.7 — per-provider A2.4 parity-gate status. THIS IS DATA, NOT CODE.
CI/coordinator maintains this file as the single source of truth for which
provider fits are trustworthy enough to OUTRANK Space-Track GP in the
synthesized CelesTrak-replacement catalog. The catalog-synthesis module
embeds this file at build time as its compiled default and also accepts a
runtime `gateStatus` override (request payload > plugin.getConfig).
Keys are the provider REGISTRY TOKENS — identical to the adapter SourceName /
the fitted OMM USER_DEFINED_SDN_SOURCE_NAME / the fit-pipeline grouping key /
the PNM topic suffix (spacex-starlink, iss, oneweb, gps, glonass, intelsat,
cpf). The packet spells Starlink as 'starlink=hard-pass'; the registry token
is 'spacex-starlink' — that is the value carried in the records, so it is the
key used here.
Gate levels:
hard-pass = A2.4 hard RMS-beat + element-space parity both GREEN. ONLY
hard-pass providers' fits may outrank Space-Track GP.
interim   = element-space tolerance check runs but the independent hard
RMS-beat is not (yet) met/available — fits are published but
NEVER outrank Space-Track GP.
blocked   = no trustworthy fit at source (no state ephemeris to fit, or an
undecodable feed) — fits (if any) never outrank Space-Track GP.
Truth as of 2026-07-13 (from the App 2 packet A2.4 progress):
spacex-starlink: hard-pass (Starlink gate live, 10/10).
iss:             hard-pass (A2.4d OWNER RULING 2026-07-13 'same ephemeris': the
beatsCelestrakSameEphemeris gate scores CelesTrak's own SupGP
elements via the SAME SGP4 over the SAME OEM states our fit used
— ours 0.071 km <= theirs 0.111 km. RMS-beat + element-space
parity both GREEN, so ISS fits may now outrank Space-Track GP).
glonass:         interim   (elementRange chain green; no independent RMS beat).
cpf:             interim   (prediction-vs-prediction; not independent).
intelsat:        interim   (non-independent MM-only tolerance).
gps:             blocked   (almanac != state ephemeris; hard gate blocked at source).
oneweb:          blocked   (LTEF encoding undecoded; fit blocked at source).
policy: Only providers at gate level 'hard-pass' may outrank a Space-Track GP record for the same NORAD, and only when the fitted OMM is STRICTLY fresher (epoch). All other cases fall back to Space-Track GP. An object present in EITHER input is never dropped.
